title: Meet the Fuzzbois
topic: what a Fuzzboi is and how its hex code sets its look

slides.narration: Stop scrolling. This little guy is a Fuzzboi.
slides.image_prompt: one round fuzzy Fuzzboi waving at the camera
slides.caption: stop scrolling. this is a fuzzboi.

slides.narration: Every Fuzzboi is hand drawn by Astra.
slides.image_prompt: a Fuzzboi sitting on a sketchbook page next to pencil lines

slides.narration: And each one gets its look from a six digit hex code.
slides.image_prompt: a Fuzzboi holding a sign with a hex colour code on it
slides.caption: its look = a 6-digit hex code

slides.narration: Change the code, and you get a whole new Fuzzboi.
slides.image_prompt: three Fuzzbois side by side in different colours

slides.narration: Which colour would yours be? Tell me in the comments.
slides.image_prompt: a Fuzzboi looking curious with a question mark
a crowd of tiny Fuzzbois cheering
slides.caption: follow for more fuzzbois
